subject: QuantaOps marketplace listing + co-sell support for Quantum Search
messages:
From: Lena Gomez <lena@quantaops.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing + co-sell support for Quantum Search

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for taking the meeting last week. QuantaOps is ready to start the marketplace listing process for our product Quantum Search (search-as-a-service for enterprise knowledge bases). We’d like to pursue a public listing on AWS Marketplace and explore co-sell support (sell-with / facilitated co-sell).

High-level asks from our side:
- Requirements and evidence needed to get listed (security, billing mapping, SKU guidance)
- Any recommended cadence for technical evidence handoff and who owns what at Redwood
- Whether Redwood can provide demo credits + a joint co-sell pitch deck for AWS reps

I’ve attached a short product brief and our current SOC2 summary. We’re ready to move quickly—procurement timeline is ~3 weeks once we have the marketplace billing info.

Attachments: product-brief-quantum-search.pdf, soc2-summary-2029.pdf

Best,
Lena Gomez
Head of Partnerships, QuantaOps
Lena@quantaops.com

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lena Gomez <lena@quantaops.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell support for Quantum Search

Hi Lena —

Appreciate the brief. We’d love to support QuantaOps on AWS Marketplace and get co-sell coverage. A couple quick things to kick off:
1) Olga will own evidence collection for listing (security, architecture, telemetry).
2) Karthik will own entitlement & meter mappings for SKU/billing.
3) I’ll coordinate commercial asks (demo credits / POC funding) and loop in marketplace ops.

Can you confirm the desired SKU model (hourly vs. metered / per-seat)? Also share a primary procurement contact and a copy of your vendor W-9 / PO template so our billing team can pre-populate the private offer flow.

Proposed next steps:
- Olga to send a concise evidence checklist by EOD today
- Karthik and I to schedule a 30-min technical/billing sync with your engineering + procurement teams tomorrow

Thanks — we’ll move quickly on this.

Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 May 2029 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell support — evidence checklist (draft)

Folks —

Draft evidence checklist for QuantaOps listing. I’m attaching a one-page checklist and the minimal artifacts we typically hand to AWS for review. Please review and call out gaps.

Evidence checklist (high level):
- Security & compliance: SOC2 summary, encryption at rest/in transit statement, data residency commitment (if required)
- Architecture: high-level diagram, network topology for private offers (VPC/peering if needed)
- Billing/metering: proposed SKU definitions, meter UUIDs, sample usage report (CSV)
- Ops: support SLA, escalation contacts, onboarding guide
- Marketing / co-sell: partner pitch deck, customer reference(s), demo kit credentials (demo user + dataset)

Attachments: evidence-checklist-redwood-marketplace.pdf, architecture-diagram.png

Links: Drive folder with templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQUANTUM-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-8342

Tasking (proposed):
- Marissa: help prepare a joint co-sell pitch deck + 2-page value props for AWS reps (due: 2029-05-10)
- Karthik: confirm SKU/metering approach and whether we need a usage-agent for metered billing (due: 2029-05-09)
- Rishi: confirm commercial ask (demo credits / POC subsidy) and lead outreach to aws-partner@amazon.com

If QuantaOps wants to pursue a private offer first (faster procurement), note we’ll need their PO template and exact billing contact.

Olga
Sr. Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell support — technical / billing Qs

Quick notes from my side after skimming the brief:
- Metering model: recommend metered usage (tokens/requests) for enterprise search; hourly SKU ok for early pilot but metered is more flexible.
- Need to confirm whether QuantaOps will host the billing agent or whether they want us to provide a lightweight shim (we can ship a small usage-agent).
- Private offer implications: if QuantaOps needs a private listing for an initial customer, AWS will want a populated seller console entry + pre-agreed price. That means we must lock SKU ids and unit pricing before generating the offer link.

Proposed 30-min sync: Thu 2029-05-09 10:00 PT — invite sent to lena@quantaops.com and procurement@quantaops.com.

Also looping in aws-partner@amazon.com to confirm timelines for facilitated co-sell review and whether we should include a joint listing request in the same submission.

Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Hi Lena / QuantaOps procurement —

Thanks — confirmed the sync for 10:00 PT today. A few things I wanted to confirm ahead of the call so billing can move fast:
- PO flow: please attach your standard PO template (or W-9) to the Drive folder. If you prefer a private offer, share the customer price and term we should propose.
- Demo credits: Redwood will provide 2 demo credits (up to $5k in usage) for the joint POC and a joint 1-pager for AWS reps. We’ll send a DocuSign for acceptance of the demo credit terms: https://www.docusign.com/link/ZXCV-8342-poc-credit
- Evidence handoff: Olga’s checklist is the source of truth. Please upload SOC2 summary and the sample usage CSV to the Drive link before EOD tomorrow so Karthik can model the meter.

Looking forward to the sync — we’ll push the seller console entries as soon as SKU ids are finalized.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
